reason: Wendy's is a quick-service restaurant franchisor/operator selling prepared burgers and meals to consumers and earning franchise royalties and restaurant sales. Lamb Weston is a manufacturer of frozen potato products sold B2B to restaurants, distributors and retailers. Lamb Weston is effectively a supplier to restaurant chains like Wendy's, not a competitor. The two share no customers and no business model; the only link is the French fry.
